evidence: The ﬁlms were grown in a commercial ﬂow-type hot-wall reactor F120 (ASM Microchemistry, Ltd). The reactor was operated under a pressure of about 1000 Pa using nitrogen as a carrier and purging gas. The cycle times used did not exceed 1.5–0.5–6.0–0.5 s, denoting the sequence metal precursor pulse –purge–O
